served: Appearance Makima Appearance Makima is a Devil resembling a human woman in her twenties, of very slight build, and marginally above average height. She has long light red/pale auburn hair, normally kept in a loose braid with bangs reaching just past her eyebrows and two longer side bangs that frame her face. Her eyes are yellow with multiple red rings within them, making them the only visible sign of her inhuman nature. Her usual Public Safety uniform consists of a white long-sleeved shirt, a black tie, black pants and brown shoes. During early arcs, she would also wear a long black trenchcoat over her uniform, showing mostly the tie and nothing else. She usually wears a calm expression on her face, and she is seen smiling most of the time throughout the anime. Personality Makima Personality On the surface, Makima seems to be a kind, gentle, social and friendly woman who is usually seen wearing a smile on her face the entire time and acts relaxed and confident even during a crisis, speaking in a professional tone to her workers. As her natural appearance is nearly identical to that of a human, she avoids disclosing her Devil nature to most of her underlings and spends much of the series posing as a human contracted to a Devil rather than a Devil herself. However, this is only a façade that she uses to fulfil her ultimate goal. After the death of Aki Hayakawa, Makima begins to reveal her true colors to Denji. Makima's true face is of someone that is Machiavellian and calculating, who sees people around her as nothing more than "dogs" she can use as much as she likes and must obey her without any hesitation for her goals. Cover & Volume Illustration Volume 10 Cover & Volume Illustration Makima is depicted standing in front of an open, dull-colored metallic door, with a wall of bright red on the other side. Makima is facing forwards with her body turned almost perpendicular to her face, and with her left hand pointing forwards in a gesture reminiscent of one of her 'Bang' abilities. The Japanese series title and English author name are a bright, dirtied yellow. The volume number, volume title, and Japanese author name are a dull pink. The English series title is white. served: Appearance Locust Devil Appearance The Locust Devil appears as a tall, broad-shouldered humanoid with a heavily segmented, insect-like body. Its head is small relative to its torso and lacks distinct human features, instead resembling an insectoid mask, and a pair of long, thin antennae extend from its head, further emphasizing its insectoid nature. Its physique is bulky and asymmetrical, covered in uneven, chitinous plating that gives it a crude, swarm-formed obsolete appearance. It has four thick arms ending in large, blunt hands with short, claw-like fingers, and unevenly proportioned legs. Four large, rigid wings resembling those of a locust extend from its back. These elongated, overlapping wings dominate its silhouette when viewed from behind, emphasizing its association with swarms rather than flight. Its overall posture is rigid and imposing, evoking both predatory stillness and the threat of sudden movement. Trivia Locust Devil Trivia It has been theorized that Seraphim, one of Chainsaw Man's followers, could be related with the Locust Devil as both of them resemble locusts. Trivia Locust Devil Trivia In the Book of Revelation, locusts emerge from the abyss after the fifth trumpet, not as a typical famine but as demonic tormentors, stinging people (those without God's seal) like scorpions for five months, causing intense agony where people seek death but can't find it, a symbolic judgment echoing Old Testament plagues but distinct from the famine brought by Famine (the Black Rider). These otherworldly locusts look like horses with human faces, golden crowns, and lion's teeth, described as having power to torment, not kill, highlighting spiritual judgment. Summary Chapter 227 Summary Noticing that his right arm is missing and that the Locust Devil is still alive, Denji asks Asa what the Devil’s deal is, only to receive an uncertain response. The Locust Devil charges at him but is knocked away, before latching onto Denji with its intestine scarf and hurling him through multiple buildings. Buried beneath the rubble, Denji is left unable to move as the Locust Devil unleashes successive swarms of locusts upon him. Recovering enough from her earlier injuries, Asa throws Denji his severed arm. Using the chains attached to it, he reels the Locust Devil toward him and finishes it off. As he devours the corpse, Asa asks if he is alright, to which Denji replies that the Devil tastes like shrimp. Asa smiles, but is immediately overtaken by Yoru, who shoots Denji through another building, tearing off his left arm in the process. Denji protests that the attack is unfair, only for Yoru to fire again, this time blasting him into a flock of pigeons and destroying both of his legs. Seemingly immobilized, Denji watches as Yoru approaches and prepares to shoot him once more. While Nayuta is currently the youngest of the four as Makima's recently born reincarnation,(Chapter 97) it is not explicitly confirmed if Fami and Yoru are older than Makima was. Together, the sisters are presumably known to have engaged in a particularly brutal battle in Hell against the Devil most feared by other Devils: "Chainsaw Man".(Chapter 87)(Chapter 98)(Chapter 99)(Chapter 104)(Chapter 135) The Horsemen seem to be the only entities in the world (Devil or otherwise) who still remember the names of the Devils devoured by Chainsaw Man, such as the Nuclear Weapons Devil, the World War II Devil, the Nazi Devil, and others. Fami derives her power from Ypositismosphobia (from Greek υποσιτισμός: "malnutrition"), the fear of hunger or starvation. Fami has supernatural and religious elements tied to her character, most notably her wanting to save people from suffering via death, as the concept of starvation reduces human need to its most basic, undeniable, human level — survival. This extreme need for mere existence can be paralleled with the absolute, all-consuming nature of faith or ultimate concerns like life and death, reflecting a warped, fatalistic benevolence tied to basic human survival. Personality Famine Devil Personality Fami has a meek and taciturn demeanor and is very outwardly emotional, in stark contrast with her sisters. She was nervous when introducing herself to students of Fourth East High School, crying throughout her entire introduction and openly bawling when she saw that nobody was paying attention to her. At the same time, she appears to have somewhat of a high opinion of herself, refusing to take out the trash because it would be a waste of her superior talents. Despite this, when she's chastised by a student for her behavior and told to go "crush ants", she actually goes outside to do so. served: Abilities / Devil Powers Cosmo Abilities / Devil Powers Total Understanding: Cosmo can telepathically send a person’s mind into her own mind, which seems to be a dimensional space that resembles a gigantic library. She would then force the target to understand everything in the universe. This renders them into a semi-catatonic state in which they are "only able to think of Halloween until they die." Once this occurs, the victim will be unable to think or say anything other than the phrase "Halloween" until their death. It is heavily implied that the target needs to copy Cosmo saying “Halloween” after she says it, and possibly for there to be some kind of direct focus, in order to work. What's more, Cosmo seems to be able to control the degree of her power and how much knowledge she infuses into her victim. This is evidenced when a server at a restaurant was able to say words other than Halloween despite Cosmo using her ability on him, and when Quanxi told Cosmo to give Santa Claus an all-out Halloween. Omniscience: Cosmo has all the knowledge of the universe inside her head. This essentially gives her a possibility to be omniscient. However, due to the fact that Cosmo herself appears to be affected by her power, likely because of her weakened state due to being a fiend, she is unable to utilize or access this knowledge in any meaningful way, being only able to think and say the word "Halloween". She doesn’t seem to be omniscient when she isn’t using her ability, as in many circumstances she seems to not know or expect many things and, in contrast to her neutral inner personality, who accepts the fate of hunting or be hunted to be natural, seemed more concerned with death and freaks out in dangerous situations. Cosmo may only be able to think completely normally when she is inside her own dimension talking to someone else that she sent there, but she does have a higher degree of functionality than her victims even outwardly, as she is not rendered semi-catatonic by her power. Abilities Cosmo Abilities As a Fiend, Cosmo can't make contracts with Devils. However, she still has all the other standard devil abilities. As the fiend that embodies the fear of the infinite knowledge of the cosmos and outer space, the more fear people have towards gaining total understanding of everything in the universe and similar concepts, the more powerful Cosmo will become. Given this devil is a manifestation of humanity's fear towards nuclear weapons, it likely has very high destructive power. Trivia Nuclear Weapons Devil Trivia The Nuclear Weapons Devil draws its power from nuclear anxiety, also known as Nucleomituphobia, an anxiety or even phobia of being faced with a potential future nuclear holocaust. It is plausible that, after the Nuclear Weapons Devil was devoured and erased from existence by the Chainsaw Devil, the Bomb Devil has weakened significantly, since humanity's fear of explosions lost its nuclear scale. Characters Introduced / Mentioned Control Devil arc Characters Introduced / Mentioned Weapon Devils Overview / Physiology Devil Overview / Physiology Due to their nature of existence, Devils do not typically have familial relationships. However, there are instances where more powerful Devils regard other Devils as their children. This was first seen when Yoru referred to the Gun Devil and Tank Devil as her "children", given how guns and tanks are weapons typically associated with warfare.(Chapter 176) Whether Yoru regards them as her children due to their connection with war or the Devils were directly created or birthed from Yoru is unclear. Yoru also implies that there are strict social hierarchies among Devils, stating that bullying is common due to a lack of social fluidity when she comments on Asa's classmates bullying her. Chapter 176 Overview / Origin Devil Overview / Origin Devils are beings born from humanity's collective fear of specific concepts, all first manifesting in Hell. They are born with a "name" that correlates to a concept. These can range from highly tangible (Fish, Tomato) to entirely abstract (Future, Curse). The concept does not have to refer to something that exists; there is no indication that ghosts, zombies or angels exist in the world, yet all these names have corresponding Devils. Each name is unique to its respective Devil, though some overlap based on specificity is possible, as there have been both a War Devil and a World War II Devil. Devils manifest according to the collective consciousness surrounding their names (for example: the Gun Devil appears to be constructed out of guns and has gun-related abilities). They are the conceptual and physical embodiment of the "name" they represent. So long as the "name" of the concept still exists and is feared by the public consciousness, they continue to reincarnate. It is implied by the Falling Devil that animal fears play a role in a Devil’s power. Trivia Light of a Star That Breaks Children's Minds Devil Trivia One notable similarity can be drawn to the rogue planet Remina from Junji Ito's manga series Remina. Both are associated with a celestial body whose mere existence induces overwhelming fear and psychological devastation, particularly through its incomprehensible and cosmic nature. Furthermore, just as Remina's appearance drives humanity into panic, hysteria, and social collapse, the light of the star that breaks children's minds is described as having the ability to shatter children's minds, suggesting a similarly catastrophic influence on human sanity and reinforcing themes of cosmic horror and madness. Abilities Mannequin Devil Abilities As a Devil, the Mannequin Devil possesses all of the standard devil abilities. Mannequin Mimicry: The Mannequin Devil's main ability, which is to transform mannequins into doppelgangers of anyone who touches it. Using those bodies, it can not only mimic the appearance of his original target, but also copy their abilities and read their thoughts to a certain extent. This ability, which allows the Mannequin Devil to transform mannequins into copies of people, can be considered the opposite of the Doll Devil's main ability, which can instead transform people into dolls. Trivia Mannequin Devil Trivia The Mannequin Devil derives its power from Automatonophobia, the fear of anthropomorphic figures, such as dolls, mannequins, robots, and animatronics. It is often confused with Pediophobia (from Greek παιδῐ́ον: "child"), which is specifically the fear of dolls. In essence, pediophobia is a type of automatonophobia, as dolls fall into the broader category of anthropomorphic figures that cause anxiety in people with automatonophobia. History / Nine Years' Savior Mannequin Devil History / Nine Years' Savior Kishibe and Quanxi both learn that the Mannequin Devil can control many mannequins that it possesses, as well as gaining the abilities and thoughts of those who have touched them. Quanxi then swiftly defeats all mannequin doppelgangers around the area, with Kishibe barely managing to defend himself in the crossfire. Afterward, the Mannequin Devil's true form is revealed and is slain by Quanxi herself, ending the threat. Appearance Mannequin Devil Appearance The Mannequin Devil's true form is described as a tiny, battered doll binded together with black feathers. served: Origin Prophecy of Nostradamus Origin The Prophecy finds its origin in the real world. Nostradamus' original writings were written in archaic French and is notoriously vague and difficult to translate. As such, there are many translations of this particular Prophecy (officially named Quatrain X.72). The following translation comes from the book "The Secrets of Nostradamus" by David Ovason: Trivia Death Devil Trivia Nostradamus' quatrain about a "great King of Terror" coming in the seventh month of 1999 was interpreted by some as predicting a catastrophic event, possibly linked to a solar eclipse, while others focused on the "King of Terror" being a specific individual or event. The total solar eclipse that occurred on August 11, 1999 (July 29 in the Julian calendar), over Europe and parts of Asia, was seen by some as a fulfillment of the Prophecy, with the "King of Terror" being interpreted as either the eclipse itself or a figure associated with it. However, others argue that the Prophecy was misinterpreted, with the "King of Terror" referring to something entirely different, like a political figure or a financial crisis. Personality Death Devil Personality Per Nostradamus' Prophecy, the Death Devil is to bring about the apocalypse, end humanity, and usher in the Age of Devils. However, it is shown that Death genuinely loves human culture beyond the personal pleasures of food, having attempted to kill herself to ensure she would never end humanity, while continuing to actively thwart the Prophecy in other ways. Thus, proving the supposed "Great King of Terror" does ultimately side with humanity over Devils. She has also been shown to have cannibalistic tendencies, choosing to eat people alive rather than quickly killing them so she can savor the flavor, even with the Famine Devil (who is both her sister and a fellow Devil whose flesh would taste bad to other Devils).(Chapter 199) Chapter 199 Prophecy of Nostradamus Prophecy of Nostradamus Prophecy of Nostradamus Prophecy of Nostradamus Type: organization Allegiance: Devils Notable Members: Death Devil Manga Debut: Chapter 122 (Mentioned) In the seventh month of 1999, a Great King of Terror will descend.
